hero.eyebrow: Otla Studio · Custom furniture atelier, Tingre Nagar
hero.lead: Sofas, curtains, mattresses and woodwork — made to measure in our own Pune workshop. Free home visit, factory-direct pricing, and a finish you will want to run your hands over.
hero.imageAlt: A warm, tailored living room with a custom sofa and natural light

about.title: Built in our workshop. Backed by our name.
about.lead: Fifteen years of Mumbai Furnishings craftsmanship, now under our own design studio. No middlemen, no showroom markups, no surprises — you speak directly to the people cutting the foam, stitching the covers and finishing the wood.

points.title: Factory-direct pricing
points.text: We manufacture in our own Tingre Nagar workshop, so you pay for the furniture — not a showroom's rent.

points.title: Materials we would use at home
points.text: Kiln-dried hardwood frames, high-density foam and fabrics chosen for Pune's climate — with samples you can touch.

points.title: A fit, not a guess
points.text: We measure your room, check the lift, the staircase and the light before a single stitch is made.

points.title: After-sales that answers
points.text: One number, one team. Repairs, refoaming and adjustments are handled by the same artisans who built it.

process.title: From first visit to final stitch.
process.lead: A simple, transparent process — with a real person on the other end of the phone.

steps.title: Free home visit
steps.text: We come to you, measure the space and listen to how you actually live. Bring us a Pinterest board or just an idea.

steps.title: Materials & quote
steps.text: Touch the fabrics, foams and wood samples. You get a clear, itemised quote — no hidden extras later.

steps.title: Handcrafted in Pune
steps.text: Your piece is built by our own artisans. We share progress photos and commit to a delivery date.

steps.title: Delivery & installation
steps.text: We deliver, assemble and place it exactly where it belongs. Then we take away every scrap of packaging.

b2b.title: Furnishing partners for hotels, offices & developers.
b2b.lead: Bulk manufacturing for residential projects, boutique hotels, restaurants, co-working spaces and corporate offices. Dedicated project managers, on-site installation and warranty across every unit.
points: GST invoicing and project-level credit terms

footerNote: Otla Studio is the design studio of Mumbai Furnishings — bespoke sofas, curtains, mattresses and fine wooden furniture, made and restored in our own Tingre Nagar workshop.
